derivation: sha256 of this file's bytes is corpus_sha256; every file hash below is sha256 of the blob at source_commit
description: MCP frames, file contents (hello.txt, 128 KiB 'large', escaped, cache fixtures) and concurrency gates are embedded in the compiled test source. Temporary directories and, for runtime-cache tests, git repositories created with /usr/bin/git are generated independently in each run.

stress.exit_status: 0 only if every run exited 0 with all load workers alive around every loaded run; 1 if any run failed; 2 if load workers did not start or disappeared; 130 or 143 if interrupted
stress.load: 8 concurrent `yes > /dev/null` busy loops, one per CPU, liveness-checked before and after every loaded run
stress.run_from: the clean source_commit worktree, by its in-tree relative path
